target_evidence.summary: Static decoding found hardware-segment upper-immediate candidates; individual sites remain private and require classification.

runtime_evidence.summary: The pinned runtime exposes subsystem bridges but no general fail-closed broker for arbitrary direct hardware-register access.

fallback.strategy: Route classified direct accesses through an allowlisted broker and reject every unknown register identifier.
fallback.limitations: The synthetic test proves fail-closed dispatch only; every target candidate still needs private classification and a behavioral oracle.

capabilities.next_gate: Classify every candidate by subsystem and prove that each required read and write has an explicit emulation contract.

target_evidence.summary: Static decoding found direct-mapped alias candidates; the aggregate includes hardware-register candidates and is not a proven execution count.

runtime_evidence.summary: The runtime translates both direct-mapped aliases in its address helper, while generated ordinary memory access assumes the cached alias base.

fallback.strategy: Normalize both direct-mapped aliases at a checked address boundary before host memory access.
fallback.limitations: The synthetic translator does not prove that every generated memory operation is routed through the boundary.

capabilities.next_gate: Run generated-code probes for both aliases and reject any access that bypasses the checked translator.

target_evidence.summary: Static decoding found a small set of TLB-instruction candidates, while the inspected project source had no direct high-level mapping calls.

runtime_evidence.summary: The pinned runtime leaves its all-entry unmap bridge empty and the pinned recompiler describes relocation support for mapped code as future work.

fallback.strategy: Represent only proven mappings in a bounded translation table and fail closed outside those ranges.
fallback.limitations: The synthetic mapping test does not establish whether any candidate executes or whether runtime remapping is required.

capabilities.next_gate: Classify the instruction candidates and prove either non-execution or a complete mapping and relocation set.

target_evidence.summary: Lexical inspection found cache-maintenance API occurrences, including use around code and overlay mutation.

runtime_evidence.summary: The pinned runtime implements the standard cache-maintenance bridges as no-ops.

fallback.strategy: Count every native-code mutation by region and require one subsequent host invalidation per recorded write before execution.
fallback.limitations: The synthetic gate proves per-write accounting and rejection only; native code-page integration and all target mutation sites remain unproven.

capabilities.next_gate: Prove every code mutation and overlay relocation reaches a host invalidation hook before execution.

target_evidence.summary: Lexical inspection found a direct standard PI transfer occurrence; additional calls may remain in unmatched or library code.

runtime_evidence.summary: Standard and handle-based transfers are implemented, but raw variants terminate and alignment or device-range gaps remain.

fallback.strategy: Use a checked byte-copy broker with explicit device bounds and exactly one completion event.
fallback.limitations: The synthetic broker does not yet reproduce hardware timing, priority, alignment quirks, or every device region.

capabilities.next_gate: Replay representative aligned and unaligned transfers and prove completion-message ordering against the private oracle.

target_evidence.summary: Lexical inspection confirms a game-specific compressed-asset path with a hand-written low-level component.

runtime_evidence.summary: The pinned runtime has an optional project callback boundary for compressed code, not a proven implementation of the target asset format.

fallback.strategy: Supply an independently reviewed callback behind strict input and output bounds, output-type validation, and missing-handler rejection.
fallback.limitations: Only the bounded callback contract is tested; target algorithm correctness and target-byte compatibility remain unproven.

capabilities.next_gate: Prove the low-level routine recompiles correctly or implement a clean-room callback and compare only private output hashes.

target_evidence.summary: Lexical inspection confirms timer API use.

runtime_evidence.summary: Timer creation, stopping, and time queries are implemented, but count-setting and one stop return-value detail remain incomplete.

capabilities.next_gate: Run deterministic one-shot, periodic, cancellation, wrap, and queue-order probes.

target_evidence.summary: Lexical inspection confirms extensive queue API use.

runtime_evidence.summary: Create, send, jam, receive, blocking, and external-message paths are implemented in the pinned runtime.

capabilities.next_gate: Verify blocking, jam order, full and empty behavior, and external completion delivery with deterministic tests.

target_evidence.summary: Lexical inspection confirms file allocation, enumeration, deletion, read, write, capacity, and repair operations.
A supported-image emulator boot exercised checker persistence and fresh-process reload as oracle evidence only; it did not execute the proposed native implementation and does not clear G2.

runtime_evidence.summary: The pinned runtime returns a no-device result for the Controller Pak file-operation family.

fallback.strategy: Implement a bounded logical note store with allocate, enumerate, read, write, delete, capacity, failure, and logical snapshot reload behavior.
fallback.limitations: The synthetic model proves only in-memory operations and fresh-model logical snapshot reload; controller discovery, atomic durable persistence, native format compatibility, repair, corruption handling, and target parity remain unproven.

capabilities.next_gate: G2 remains blocked: run allocation, enumeration, deletion, read, write, capacity, persistence/reload, and failure paths through the proposed native implementation and compare aggregate results with the private oracle.

target_evidence.summary: Static decoding and source inspection expose many trap-like candidates plus a boot-time self-check path; candidates are not proven executions.

runtime_evidence.summary: Break and switch-bound hooks terminate, while the base runtime lacks the syscall handler emitted by the pinned recompiler.

fallback.strategy: Assign every proven trap an opaque ID and explicit abort, emulate, or defer disposition; reject unknown and duplicate sites.
fallback.limitations: The synthetic inventory proves completeness enforcement only; all static candidates require private reachability and intent classification.

capabilities.next_gate: Classify every reachable trap and boot self-check path, then prove a non-stub disposition with private replay evidence.

save_devices.next_gate: Probe erase, buffered write, array write, read, status, persistence, and interrupted-operation behavior.

fallback.strategy: Provide a bounded logical note store with deterministic errors, enumeration, and fresh-model logical snapshot reload using only synthetic test bodies.
fallback.limitations: No target save body is tracked; controller discovery, atomic durable persistence, native format compatibility, repair, corruption handling, and target parity remain unproven.

save_devices.next_gate: The emulator checker result is oracle-only and does not clear G2; G2 requires a persistence/reload round-trip through the proposed native implementation plus operation and error parity.
Probe discovery, start, stop, disconnect, and Controller Pak versus Rumble Pak switching.
Confirm the selected game mode never selects EEPROM before excluding it from the shipped matrix.
Classify the generic transfer occurrence and test SRAM only if a reachable mode selects it.

trap_inventory.next_gate: Distinguish executable traps from padding or decoder false positives and assign each reachable site a disposition.
Classify every reachable candidate and implement the emitted handler contract before generated code can link.
Keep the fail-closed diagnostic and prove valid jump-table inputs never reach it.
Reproduce the self-check in private replay and implement an explicit compatibility behavior without blind stubbing.
